title: Common Bile Duct Stone Management: What Have we Learned?
brief_summary: In unfit elderly people with comorbid disease leaving the gallbladder in situ is justified after ERCP treatment. Cholangitis is more present in elderly people. The purpose of this study is to determine leaving the gallbladder in situ does not reduce the morbidity rate after ERCP for common bile duct stones(CBDS), especially in patients with cholangitis.
